name: Voice Input
description: Dictate into the composer. whisper.cpp turns your speech into text on this Mac, with no network.

args:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-fork)
(allow process-exec (literal "/bin/sh") (literal "/bin/bash") (literal "/bin/dash") (literal "/usr/bin/base64") (literal "/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli") (subpath "/opt/homebrew/Cellar/whisper-cpp") (literal "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli") (subpath "/usr/local/Cellar/whisper-cpp"))
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow file-read* (subpath "/System/Library") (subpath "/System/Volumes/Preboot/Cryptexes") (subpath "/System/Cryptexes") (subpath "/usr/lib") (subpath "/usr/share") (subpath "/bin") (subpath "/usr/bin") (subpath "/private/var/select") (subpath "/opt/homebrew") (subpath "/usr/local") (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/urandom") (regex #"^/Users/[^/]+/\.local/share/whisper/ggml-(base|small)\.en\.bin$"))
(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null"))
